verification_report.summary: The proof packet is correct. The auxiliary rigid-etale, quasi-smooth, annular, and finite-group arguments pass sequential verification. For the stated Frobenius descent proposition, finite surjective radiciality gives a homeomorphism on Berkovich points; Frobenius powers descend each rational chart and every upstairs analytic unit; reducedness supplies the required injection; and the resulting unit-log expressions prove R-PL descent. The subsequent simplicial-toric theorem's lattice cover, characteristic factorization, q-power affinoid base change, constant-group and radicial descent, scalar descent, and harmonicity argument are also valid. All cited external statements and the frozen D1/D2 dependencies match their applications.
